content.text: Q: Does FeSL's XACML engine allow the use of conditions with #anyURI values?  If so, this can probably be closed as WontFix in the interest of focusing efforts on FeSL.

Personally I'm not sure, but I think there is a need to cross-check that everything that Fedora's XACML implementation currently supports is supported within FeSL, and raise tickets for anything that isn't - so probably include this in that effort.
I don't think the patched xacml library Fedora has been using supports matching functions against anyURI.
In some (and possibly all) cases, the XACML engine cannot correctly process attributes of type '
This means that the following effectively cannot be used in the context of Fedora XACML policies:
The AttributeFinderModule class correctly handles other types of content but the specific condition for #anyURI values is omitted. Adding this code corrects the issue.

I have attached a code diff and a sample policy that should protect from dissemination all datastreams with a formatURI set to 'vital:protected' for a particular object. This does not occur, in our experience, without the modification.

Q: Does FeSL's XACML engine allow the use of conditions with #anyURI values? If so, this can probably be closed as WontFix in the interest of focusing efforts on FeSL.

Personally I'm not sure, but I think there is a need to cross-check that everything that Fedora's XACML implementation currently supports is supported within FeSL, and raise tickets for anything that isn't - so probably include this in that effort.

If I remember right: https://fedora-commons.org/jira/browse/FCREPO-453?focusedCommentId=14798&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#action_14798

I don't think the patched xacml library Fedora has been using supports matching functions against anyURI.

renderedFields.description:
In some (and possibly all) cases, the XACML engine cannot correctly process attributes of type 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#anyURI'.

This means that the following effectively cannot be used in the context of Fedora XACML policies:

urn:fedora:names:fedora:2.1:resource:object:formatUri
urn:fedora:names:fedora:2.1:resource:datastream:formatUri
urn:fedora:names:fedora:2.1:resource:datastream:newFormatUri
urn:fedora:names:fedora:2.1:resource:datastream:location
urn:fedora:names:fedora:2.1:resource:datastream:newLocation
urn:fedora:names:fedora:2.1:resource:bdef:location
urn:fedora:names:fedora:2.1:resource:bmech:location

The AttributeFinderModule class correctly handles other types of content but the specific condition for #anyURI values is omitted. Adding this code corrects the issue.

I have attached a code diff and a sample policy that should protect from dissemination all datastreams with a formatURI set to 'vital:protected' for a particular object. This does not occur, in our experience, without the modification.
